## Geometry and neighborhoods

Planned: PCA, t-SNE, UMAP, k-nearest neighbors, k-means, and hierarchical clustering.

### Database sequence search

- [BLAST seed-and-extend search](algorithms/blast-seed-and-extend-search.qmd): word seeds, candidate extension, HSPs, and E-value interpretation
- [FASTA sequence-search algorithm](algorithms/fasta-sequence-search-algorithm.qmd): diagonal word clustering and staged local-alignment refinement

## Graphs and optimization

Planned: Louvain, Leiden, dynamic programming, integer linear programming, minimum spanning trees, and neighbor joining.

## Sequence and probabilistic models

Planned: BWT/FM-index, hidden Markov models, MCMC, and Bayesian inference.

### Pairwise sequence alignment

- [Global sequence alignment: Needleman–Wunsch](algorithms/needleman-wunsch-global-alignment.qmd): optimal end-to-end alignment, scoring, traceback, affine gaps, and interpretation
- [Local sequence alignment: Smith–Waterman](algorithms/smith-waterman-local-alignment.qmd): optimal subsequence alignment, local restart, statistical meaning, and practical diagnostics
